Never allow your characters to confess their love in the first chapter.

Make them suffer.

Make them yearn.

Preferably during a thunderstorm.

I assure you, every knot was tied with the utmost care.
The library has acquired a new pencil sharpener. Please do not interpret this as permission to borrow the pencils.

replies.text: An encouraging investment in literacy.
Please submit a capital equipment acquisition form.
It cost ninety-nine cents.

text: Breakfast: toast, marmalade, and a perfectly respectable cup of tea. The marmalade has made a rather convincing attempt to escape.

replies.text: DARLING, YOU NEED A NAPKIN.
I had one. The marmalade won.

text: I made Birthday Mouse a sandwich. It fell over. I made another one. That one fell over too.

replies.text: They were both very good sandwiches.
Was there blueberry cobbler?
No but there is now.

text: Happy Valentine's Day to everybody, especially Derpy, who made me a card with eleven hearts and one potato.

replies.text: The potato is also a heart.
I think it is beautiful.
It is.

text: As former interim mayor, I would like to remind the public that I remain available for ceremonial ribbon cuttings.

replies.text: There are no ribbon cuttings scheduled.
I have my own ribbon.
Please do not cut municipal property without authorization.

text: Someone left a very nice chair in the hallway. I sat in it. Apparently it was part of an ongoing argument.

replies.text: THAT WAS MY CHAIR.
It's quite comfortable.
My client disputes the ownership of the hallway.

text: Available for birthdays, anniversaries, and tasteful porch performances. Requests accepted. Volume negotiable.

replies.text: Lower.
HIGHER.
This is why I need a contract.

text: Is anyone else getting a strange rattling noise when the wind picks up, or is that just my window?

replies.text: Mine does it too.
Not me.
That was not reassuring.

text: Court will recess for lunch. Court has not yet convened. This is a scheduling decision.

replies.text: Your Honor, there are motions pending.
They can pend after lunch.
I support this court.

text: Spent the afternoon looking for my glasses. Found them. They were in the one place I specifically said I had already checked.

replies.text: Case closed.
Did you check there first?
I decline to answer.

text: For the record, I have never damaged a porch. I merely disagree with its current shape.

replies.text: Please stop posting about the ongoing investigation.
The shape was bad.
Neither of you should be making statements.

text: Somebody has been leaving birdseed where the squirrels can see it but cannot reach it. This feels deliberate.

replies.text: Good.
I have a plan.
Please do not.

text: A reminder that a good performance requires rehearsal. A loud performance requires only enthusiasm. We have rather a lot of the latter.

replies.text: I FEEL PERSONALLY ADDRESSED.
Then the acoustics are excellent.

text: Morning report from the fairgrounds: one lost glove, two empty popcorn bags, and an extremely suspicious hot dog wrapper.

replies.text: That wrapper was already there.
Why would you know that?
Exactly.

text: I am not saying the fairgrounds need a formal snack committee. I am saying there are currently no standards.

replies.text: Who appointed you?
The absence of standards.
That is not how committees work.

text: Family announcement: the picnic has been moved twenty minutes later. This is not a referendum on anyone's potato salad.

replies.text: Then why was my potato salad mentioned in the group chat?
Because it arrived warm.
And now we're doing this publicly.

text: I made a list of everything we need for the picnic. Somehow the list has become an argument about chairs.

replies.text: We need chairs.
We have chairs.
We have seven people and five chairs.

text: Someone please tell Rocky that bringing home 'interesting things' is not the same as cleaning up the neighborhood.

replies.text: They were historically significant.
One was a spoon.
Thank you, Rudy.

text: I am hosting tea at four. Please do not arrive at three to help. Last time, the help ate the biscuits.

replies.text: I was checking freshness.
And were they fresh?
Extremely.

text: Professional reminder: proper skeletal posture begins with an awareness of one's center of gravity. Slouching is not a personality.

replies.text: SOME OF US ARE ARTISTS.
Then consider this a critique.
Please do not invoice my client for that.

text: I have been told my tea is too hot. I waited until it stopped steaming. Apparently that was not enough.

replies.text: It was lovely once it cooled.
I put an ice cube in mine.
That was very clever.

text: Good morning. I have opened all the curtains and declared today a fresh start. Please ignore the pile of yesterday beside the door.

replies.text: How large is the pile?
Fresh starts do not answer questions.
I recommend documenting the pile.

text: I would like to know who keeps moving the little table. It is not a complaint. I would simply like to stop walking into it.

replies.text: The table has excellent natural light there.
The table does not need natural light.
We disagree.

text: A note to the younger performers: opening night is not the time to discover that your costume has pockets. Check beforehand.

replies.text: And rehearse your exits.
MY COSTUMES ALWAYS HAVE POCKETS.
That explains the rattling.

text: The next time somebody says 'just a small gathering,' I would like that phrase defined in writing.

replies.text: Small is a financial category.
IT WAS INTIMATE.
There were forty-seven people.

text: NOTICE TO MANAGEMENT: The afternoon treat allocation is under review. No further comment at this time.

replies.text: Your allocation was delivered at 2:00.
That was the morning allocation, delayed.
Court will consider the matter after lunch.
